description: Use this when the user asks what a local service costs in a city (e.g. 'how much is a deep clean in NYC?'). Returns a rough range from Servana businesses' posted rates with a confidence level ('high' = 5+ local priced businesses, 'medium' = 2-4, 'low' = 0-1, then a category-wide median) and an explanation naming the sample. Always call it an estimate, never a quote: each business sets its own price. Do not use for one business's prices; use get_vendor.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. 'new-york', 'tampa', 'los-angeles'). For New York City use 'new-york'.

hours.description: Optional: estimated hours needed, if known. Overrides job_size for hourly-rate services.

job_size.description: Rough size of the job. Defaults to 'medium'.

service.description: Service category slug: 'cleaning-and-organizing' (house cleaning, decluttering), 'laundry-washing' (wash and fold), 'med-spa' (botox, facials, skincare), 'yoga', 'personal-training', 'photography', 'home-services' (handyman, home upkeep), 'personal-services'

state.description: US state, as a name or slug (e.g. 'new-york', 'florida'). Two-letter codes like 'NY' also work.

name: estimate_service_request
